'''Gray Squadron''', also known as '''Gray Wing''' or '''Gray Group''', was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that flew [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|A/SF-01 B-wing]] and [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==History==
Active by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> Gray Squadron was a mixed [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit led by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm]] serving the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="CSWEGL" /> Although the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] was equipped with modern [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|A/SF-01 B-wing starfighters]],<ref name="XWA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref> Salm and other veteran [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]<ref name="CCGGSYP">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Gray Squadron Y-wing Pilot}}</ref> chose to fly venerable [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]], citing their reliability with the comment that "they've always gotten me home in one piece."<ref name="CCGCS">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Colonel Salm}}</ref> The unit's B-wings and some of its Y-wings were marked with [[Color/Legends|gray]] striping to reflect their squadron affiliation,<ref name="PMGSY">{{PocketModel|set=Base Set|cardname=Gray Squadron Y-wing|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/ship05a.jpg}}</ref><ref name="PMGSB">{{PocketModel|set=Ground Assault|cardname=Gray Squadron B-wing|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/shipga02c.jpg}}</ref> while other Gray Squadron Y-wings bore yellow markings.<ref name="CCGGS2">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Gray Squadron 2}}</ref> For the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Gray Leader/Legends|Gray Leader]] Salm and his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Telsij/Legends|Telsij]],<ref name="CCGLT">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Telsij}}</ref> [[Gray Two]],<ref name="CCGGS2" /> were assigned [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] pilots [[Kin Kian (Human)|Kin Kian]] and [[Karie Neth/Legends|Karie Neth]] as their Y-wing [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]].<ref name="CCGKK">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Kin Kian}}</ref><ref name="CCGKN">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Karie Neth}}</ref>

===Battle of Endor===
Assigned a key role at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]],<ref name="CCGGSYP" /> Gray Squadron, otherwise identified as Gray Group<ref name="OSG">[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> or Gray Wing, was one of four main Rebel [[Battle group/Legends|battle groups]] present for the conflict. While the term "Gray Wing" was used to refer to the squadron as a whole,<ref name="CSWEGW" /> it was also used as a call sign by an [[Gray Wing|individual pilot]], one of the first casualties of the battle.<ref name="AGTTSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> Ordered to disable any [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] between [[Gold Leader/Legends|Gold Leader]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star]],<ref name="CCGCS" /> Colonel Salm responded to the [[General/Legends|general's]] call for all [[Fighter wing/Legends|wings]] to report in. Approaching the [[Space station/Legends|space station]], Gray Squadron was ambushed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE series/Legends|fighters]], with Telsij remarking on their overwhelming numbers.<ref name="ROTJ" /> The squadron took heavy casualties early in the battle,<ref name="CSWEGW" /> including "Gray Wing"<ref name="AGTTSWU" /> and [[Gray Three/Legends|Gray Three]], Lieutenant [[Ekelarc Yong/Legends|Ekelarc Yong]],<ref name="TVC">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Shadows of the Dark Side|pack=(Toys R Us Exclusive) Battle Over Endor (1 of 2)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TVCEXBattleOverEndor1.asp}}</ref> who was hit by fire from a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]], triggering explosions in his Y-wing's [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] before he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a collision with an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> As General Calrissian entered the Death Star's superstructure to destroy its [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]], he encountered a blockage in the primary access tunnel, and was forced to take an alternative route. On Calrissian's orders, Gray Group unblocked the primary route, allowing the ''Falcon'' and [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] to escape the exploding space station and bring the Rebel Alliance to victory.<ref name="XWA" />

*Gray Leader - Colonel Horton Salm
**Kin Kian {{C|gunner}}
*Gray Two - Lieutenant Telsij
**Karie Neth {{C|gunner}}
*Gray Three - Lieutenant Ekelarc Yong
*Gray Wing - Unknown pilot<ref name="AGTTSWU" />

==Behind the scenes==
Contrary to the [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|film]],<ref name="ROTJ" /> in the [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|novelization of ''Return of the Jedi'']], "Gray Leader" is interrupted while reporting in,<ref name="ROTJn">{{Film|VI}}</ref> and was confirmed to have been killed in the [[1984]] reference book ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''.<ref name="AGTTSWU" /> However, the death of Gray Leader was contradicted by his later establishment as Horton Salm, a character active in the post-Endor era.<ref name="CSWEHS">{{CSWECite|III|124|Salm, Horton}}</ref> Similarly, Karie Neth, another Gray Squadron member, can be seen alive on Endor following the battle in ''Return of the Jedi''.<ref name="ROTJ" />

The [[1999]] video game [[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]] uses the spelling "Gr'''e'''y Group" to refer to this unit,<ref name="XWA" /> while most other sources, including that game's [[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|Official Strategy Guide]] use the spelling "Gr'''a'''y".<ref name="OSG" />
